mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND code = #{code} AND used = 0 AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_code (phone, code, expire_time, used, create_time) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{expireTime}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_code SET used = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND used = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sms_code WHERE expire_time < NOW()
